Technological University of the Philippines Cubers Association (TCA) - Visayas, in line with Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee (NSOC) presents to you **Negros Speedcubing Cup 2024**. A World Cube Association sanctioned competition held in City Mall Mandalagan, Bacolod City.

All other necessary information about **Negros Speedcubing Cup 2024** can be found in the following tabs above.
